_note: Static wiki reference data for planning cooking-ingredient purchases (a future session will build a cooking order that minimizes ingredients needed) -- NOT used to link memory values. Utensil fields (frying_pan, knife, mixer, oven, pot, rolling_pin, seasoning_set, whisk) are booleans. ingredient_item_1..7 hold each recipe's required ingredients (7 is the max, Vegetable Pizza); unused slots are null. stamina_recovery/fatigue_recovery are numbers parsed from the recipe's own infobox; both are null wherever the source page genuinely doesn't document a value (e.g. the wiki lists 'N/A' for the four seasonal 'Sun' gift items -- they have no recovery value at all). learning_method is the recipe's 'Where to Learn' value verbatim (short form, e.g. 'Inspiration', a villager name, or 'Tasty Time TV Show (Nth episode)') -- this is the short label, not the full event description; some pages label this row 'Obtained From' instead of 'Where to Learn' and that's used as a fallback where present. ingredient_use_1..4/number_of_dishes_1..4 (4 is the max row count found, e.g. Vegetable Pizza) come from the page's 'How to Learn' Ingredient/Number-of-Dishes-Required table, used when a recipe unlocks via repeated cooking rather than an NPC event; both are null past a recipe's actual row count, and entirely null for event-learned or already-known recipes. Butter and the 6 Mayonnaise size variants (S/M/L/G/P/X) live on a differently-templated wiki page (animal-products, not recipes). Each Mayonnaise size is treated as its own ingredient/recipe: ingredients are Oil plus the matching egg quality (S=Regular Egg, M=Good Egg, L=Excellent Egg, G=Golden Egg, P=Platinum Egg, X=X Egg), per that page's 'Mayonnaise Tiers' table, which also supplied stamina_recovery per size (S=+1 ... X=+6 STA) -- not available from the standard recipe infobox, hand-extracted from that page. learning_method for the 6 sizes was likewise hand-extracted from that page's separate 'Where to Learn the Recipes' table (a different structure than the standard automated parse): S/M unlock via Tasty Time TV Show (Episode 4), while L/G/P/X each unlock by cooking a set number of dishes using the PREVIOUS tier's own Mayonnaise egg (e.g. L needs Good-Egg dishes, which is M's own ingredient) -- a real progressive-unlock chain, not a wiki inconsistency. fatigue_recovery remains null for Butter and all 6 Mayonnaise sizes -- genuinely not documented anywhere on that page, not a parsing gap. Recipe count is 120, not the ~229/180+ an early automated fetch of the list page guessed -- the true count was confirmed by parsing the page's raw HTML table directly (120 <tr> rows), which is what this whole file is built from (every individual recipe page was also fetched and parsed as raw HTML/regex, not summarized, for reliability).
